title: Perfect-complex descent on an open subscheme
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R_i a system of Noetherian commutative rings with a cocone c, i an index, X_i a scheme and s:X_i → Spec R_i. For an open U of X_i define P(U) as follows. For every open immersion f:Z → X_i with image U, set t=s∘f. Every perfect object E of D(O_(Z ×_(R_i) c.pt)) descends to a perfect object E_j of D(O_(Z ×_(R_i) R_j)) for some j≥i, together with an isomorphism Lg* E_j ≅ E for the canonical base-change map g induced by c_j. Schemes, derived categories, perfectness, pullback and cocones are as in [def-pc-scheme], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-pc-derived-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. This is a predicate, with no assertion that it holds.

def PerfectDescentOnOpen
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)]
    (c : Cocone R) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : Xi.Opens) : Prop
